formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : List (ℕ × ℕ) := [((0 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((0 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((1 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((2 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (7 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((3 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ)), ((4 : ℕ), (13 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (10 : ℕ)), ((5 : ℕ), (12 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (8 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (9 : ℕ)), ((6 : ℕ), (11 : ℕ))]; have x2 : (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x2 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => ∃ (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), (↑x3, ↑x4) ∈ x1 ∧ x2 x3 = Bool.true ∧ x2 x4 = Bool.true; have x3 : (Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool) => (x2 x3 ∧ ∀ (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), x3 x4 = Bool.true → ¬x2 (Function.update x3 x4 Bool.false)) ∨ ¬x2 x3 ∧ ∀ (x4 : Fin (14 : ℕ)), x3 x4 = Bool.false → x2 (Function.update x3 x4 Bool.true); ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → (∀ (x6 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x3 x6 → x6 (0 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) = Bool.false ∨ x6 (7 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) = Bool.false → (x4.eval (List.ofFn x6) = Bool.true ↔ x2 x6)) → x4.eval (List.ofFn fun (x7 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x7 = (0 : Fin (14 : ℕ)) ∨ x7 = (7 : Fin (14 : ℕ)))) = Bool.false → (25 : ℕ) ≤ x4.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: Heawood graph as in the parent (21 edges, F its edge function on 14 inputs): an AND/OR fan-in-at-most-two circuit that agrees with F on every minimal true and every maximal false input with x0 or x7 false, and is false when exactly x0 and x7 are true, has at least 25 gates.
title: It is false that: A step toward: Every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function of the Heawood graph has at least 27 gates
